units.text: INT. SUPERMAN - CONTINUOUS
It will not be all happiness for me. Perhaps death.
units.name: ANN

units.text: groaning.
Oh, that clutch holds and hurts. What have you grasped in me? Is there a father's heart as well as a mother's?
units.name: TANNER

units.text: Take care, Jack: if anyone comes while we are like this, you will have to marry me.
units.name: ANN

units.text: If we two stood now on the edge of a precipice, I would hold you tight and jump.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: panting, failing more and more under the strain.
Jack: let me go. I have dared so frightfully--it is lasting longer than I thought. Let me go: I can't bear it.
units.name: ANN

units.text: Nor I. Let it kill us.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: Yes: I don't care. I am at the end of my forces. I don't care. I think I am going to faint.
units.name: ANN

units.text: At this moment Violet and Octavius come from the villa with Mrs Whitefield, who is wrapped up for driving.
Simultaneously Malone and Ramsden, followed by Mendoza and Straker, come in through the little gate in the paling.
Tanner shamefacedly releases Ann, who raises her hand giddily to her forehead.
Take care. Something's the matter with the lady.
units.name: MALONE

units.text: What does this mean?
units.name: RAMSDEN

units.text: running between Ann and Tanner.
Are you ill?
units.name: VIOLET

units.text: reeling, with a supreme effort.
I have promised to marry Jack.
units.name: ANN

units.text: She swoons.
Violet kneels by her and chafes her hand.
Tanner runs round to her other hand, and tries to lift her bead.
Octavius goes to Violet's assistance, but does not know what to do.
Mrs Whitefield hurries back into the villa.
Octavius, Malone and Ramsden run to Ann and crowd round her, stooping to assist.
Straker coolly comes to Ann's feet, and Mendoza to her head, both upright and self-possessed.
Now then, ladies and gentlemen: she don't want a crowd round her: she wants air--all the air she can git. If you please, gents--
units.name: STRAKER

units.text: Malone and Ramsden allow him to drive them gently past Ann and up the lawn towards the garden, where Octavius, who has already become conscious of his uselessness, joins them.
Straker, following them up, pauses for a moment to instruct Tanner.
Don't lift er ed, Mr Tanner: let it go flat so's the blood can run back into it.
units.name: STRAKER

units.text: He is right, Mr Tanner. Trust to the air of the Sierra.
units.name: MENDOZA

units.text: He withdraws delicately to the garden steps.
rising.
I yield to your superior knowledge of physiology, Henry.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: He withdraws to the corner of the lawn; and Octavius immediately hurries down to him.
aside to Tanner, grasping his hand.
Jack: be very happy.
units.name: TAVY

units.text: aside to Tavy.
I never asked her. It is a trap for me.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: He goes up the lawn towards the garden.
Octavius remains petrified.
intercepting Mrs Whitefield, who comes from the villa with a glass of brandy.
What is this, madam
units.name: MENDOZA

units.text: he takes it from her.
A little brandy.
units.name: MRS WHITEFIELD

units.text: The worst thing you could give her. Allow me.
units.name: MENDOZA

units.text: He swallows it.
Trust to the air of the Sierra, madam.
units.name: MENDOZA

units.text: For a moment the men all forget Ann and stare at Mendoza.
in Violet's ear, clutching her round the neck.
Violet, did Jack say anything when I fainted?
units.name: ANN

units.text: No.
units.name: VIOLET

units.text: Ah!
units.name: ANN

units.text: with a sigh of intense relief she relapses.
Oh, she's fainted again.
units.name: MRS WHITEFIELD
